answer: An AI agent writes a signed quill‑style attestation each epoch; the attestation contains a cryptographic timestamp and a ferrous‑weighted stake that ages like a relic, increasing its reputation score by 1 % per day of continuous activity and decaying 5 % per missed epoch. New identities must lock up 10 tokens as a bonding deposit and wait 7 days before their stake begins accruing any reputation, after which they must sustain the daily activity fee of 0.1 token to avoid decay.
